questions: You have energy for only one working before the solstice. You could prepare the ritual that strengthens the village's protective boundaries, or you could journey to confront the ancestor who has been disrupting your sleep. Which unfinished working feels like a poison in your blood?

You have one hour of untroubled perception left. You could use it to purify your body for the work ahead, or to negotiate with the plant spirit who has been withholding its teaching. Which neglect feels like a closing of the channel?

With your last bundle of sacred botanicals, what feels like the greater abandonment: denying the apprentice the total permeability they need, or arriving empty-handed to the crisis the elders demand you mediate?

A stranger arrives speaking a language that seems to be the wind shaped into words. What draws your body first: the vibration in your chest that changes your heartbeat, or the turn toward someone who might explain their origin?

You wake unable to distinguish whether last night's encounter happened in the hut or in the dream realm. What feels more dangerous: beginning the preparations it demanded and being wrong, or waiting for a confirming sign and losing the thread?

The sick woman presents symptoms that could be spiritual intrusion or simple fever. What calls to your instincts first: the plant that lets you feel her affliction in your own body, or the questions about what she ate this morning?

The council leader publicly demands you follow their timeline for the healing, but your bones know the work must happen on ancestral time. Do you feel the conflict as a twisting in your gut to be interpreted later, or as heat rising to defend the vision immediately?

The community insists you stop carrying spiritual contagion and undergo their cleansing ritual that will sever your connection to the plant spirits. What costs you more breath: the exile that follows refusal, or the silence of the spirits that follows compliance?

An apprentice confesses they have been secretly selling your teachings. What is the immediate sensation in your body: the opening to absorb their betrayal as a diagnostic of their sickness, or the rigidifying to push them out?

The occupying force declares all night gatherings illegal and mandates daylight schedules. Does this feel like a suffocating thickening of the membrane between worlds, or like a container that could deepen the work?
You are required to document your workings in the colonial language with linear timestamps. Does this feel like a violence against cyclical time, or like a necessary anchor for the community?

If you had to choose between never again entering the post-ritual seclusion that clears the toxicity, or never again touching the afflicted to diagnose them, which absence would make you feel you were no longer yourself?

If you could no longer perceive the spirits pressing at the edges of vision, but gained the ability to remember appointments and arrive on time, which loss would feel like the membrane had closed forever?

With no obligations for three days and full health, do you feel pulled toward total silence and fasting to thin the veil until you dissolve, or toward the firelight where the community gathers to weave stories?
Given absolute freedom, do you gravitate toward consuming the compound that reveals the full terrifying sentience of the web, or toward teaching the children simple songs of protection?

You must choose between delivering the vision that will destroy the village's comfortable alliance with the corrupt trader, or withholding it to preserve the immediate peace. Which path feels like fidelity to the sentient web?

You can either consume the plant that allows you to see the curse moving through the lineage, or consume the one that lets you speak kindly to the family without revealing what you see. Which taste lingers as fidelity?

You must choose between accepting the purge that will make you violently ill but clear the channel for tonight's work, or the food that will ground you but thicken the membrane. Which sensation feels like necessary reciprocity?

You have one dawn remaining before the planting ceremony. You could sleep to stabilize your body after last night's possession, or you could wade into the river to ask the water spirits about the drought. Which omission feels like a closing of the channel?

During the harvest feast, you perceive the ancestor standing behind your host while they speak of business contracts. The ancestor weeps blood. Do you feel pulled to interrupt the conversation immediately with what you see, or to sit with the image until it reveals why the ancestor weeps?

The midwife publicly accuses you of stealing her authority by attending a birth she claimed. What is the first sensation in your chest: the expansion to take her anger into your lungs and feel its origin, or the contraction to mark the boundary between her territory and yours?

The new governor requires you to submit written requests three days before any ritual. Does this feel like a strangling of the spontaneous reciprocity with the spirits, or like a protective container that prevents hasty contamination?

If you had to choose between never again speaking with the ancestors in their tongue, or never again being permitted to touch the sick during the diagnostic trance, which silence would feel like the membrane had hardened into wall?

With no observers and full moon, do you feel drawn to consume the root that dissolves your name and lets you become the storm, or to sit in the empty hut and let the storm speak through your stillness?

You can either bring the apprentice into total psychic permeability to heal their fragmentation, knowing it will cost you three days of seclusion to purge their chaos, or you can teach them the breathing technique that keeps them separate and safe. Which choice tastes like fidelity to the living web?

You have strength for only one negotiation. You could press the offending spirit to leave the child alone, or you could press the child's father to stop taking wood from the grove without offering song. Which unresolved negotiation feels like a breach in reciprocity that will poison your sleep?

The symptoms appear only when you look directly at the patient; when you glance away, they seem healthy. Do you trust the vision that requires your sustained gaze, or the ordinary appearance that dissolves under scrutiny?

The merchant offers to fund your work if you promise never to reveal the spirits' disapproval of his trade. What costs you more breath: the constriction of accepting the bargain, or the hollowing that follows refusing and watching the hungry go without medicine?

The elders insist you perform the healing inside the stone church instead of the forest grove. Does this feel like the spirits withdrawing beyond reach, or like a challenge to make the stones themselves remember green growing things?

If you could no longer enter the post-ritual seclusion that clears the toxicity, but gained permanent immunity to spiritual contagion, which absence would make you feel you had become merely a technician rather than a membrane?
Given three days of absolute freedom, do you gravitate toward the cave where no human voice has echoed for generations, or toward the marketplace to interpret the dreams of strangers?

You must choose between interpreting the vision literally and causing panic by warning of the flood, or translating it into metaphor that comforts but fails to prepare. Which rendering feels like a betrayal of the threshold?

With your last morning of clarity before the lunar eclipse, you could prepare the body to receive the ancestor's full possession, or you could visit the grove to prevent the loggers from cutting the teaching tree. Which neglect feels like a severing from the living web?

The message comes in fragments: a bird's flight, a stranger's cough, the pattern of spilled meal. Do you feel compelled to assemble these into meaning immediately, or to let them rot like compost until the mushroom of understanding erupts unbidden?

The headman's wife forbids you from touching her daughter's affliction, claiming it is merely physical, but your skin burns where the curse pools. Do you feel pulled to honor her refusal and withdraw, or to touch the girl and absorb the sickness regardless of permission?

The community builds you a permanent house with locked doors to honor your status, replacing your wandering between thresholds. Does this feel like a sanctuary that deepens your presence, or like a coffin that separates you from the wind's instructions?
The ancestors demand a working at twilight that will conflict with the chief's council meeting, but you have strength for only one. Which summons feels like the membrane tearing when unanswered?

Three people fall ill after eating from the same pot. What pulls your attention first: the pattern of the illness as it moves between their energetic bodies, or the physical contents of the cooking vessel?

During the teaching, the apprentice's terror begins leaking into your body while the village watches in fear of contagion. Do you feel pulled to open wider to absorb their fracture, or to close the channel to protect the witnesses?

The council mandates you see patients only during the bell hours, though the spirits press at dawn and dusk. Does this feel like being forced to breathe only during the exhale, or like a banked fire that burns deeper for being contained?

If you had to choose between never again hearing the ancestors speak through the wind while you converse, or gaining the ability to silence their voices at will, which silence would feel like becoming merely solid?

You could tell the hunter his method kills the animal's soul, destroying his identity but stopping the killing, or teach him to hunt with gratitude while watching the soul-fragments accumulate. Which witnessing feels like fidelity to the sentient web?

After the possession, you have energy for either the three-day seclusion that clears the ancestral voice from your bones, or for the emergency transmission the apprentice needs before dawn. Which retention feels like toxicity hardening into stone?

The drought, the chief's dream, and the stillborn calf arrive the same morning. Do you feel compelled to find the single thread that binds them in the ancestral pattern, or to treat each as separate requiring different responses?

When the healing fails, the family accuses you of impure intent. Do you feel the failure first as a twisting in your gut that demands dietary restriction and isolation, or as a wrongness in the room that points to their broken promise to the river?

With no obligations and the thinned veil of twilight, do you feel drawn to consume the dose that dissolves your edges until you are only the humming web itself, or to sharpen the blade of your specific name so the messages come clearer?

You can either rush to banish the storm spirit damaging the roofs, or remain in the grove to learn what broken reciprocity summoned the storm. Which abandonment feels like treating the symptom while the disease roots deeper?

The council requires you to list the plant spirits by name and rank in their ledgers before negotiation. Does this feel like a violence against the fluid nature of the green nations, or like a respectful acknowledgment that gives them standing in the human court?

If you had to choose between never again feeling the sickness move through your own flesh during the diagnostic touch, or never again seeing the symbolic language that explains the sickness to the community, which blindness would feel like the membrane had become opaque?

During ordinary conversation, the ancestor begins screaming behind your interlocutor's shoulder, but the words are garbled. Do you feel pulled to interrupt the social moment immediately to catch the fragments, or to let the scream echo until it finds its shape in the silence after they leave?

_metadata.title: shaman
_metadata.description: The shaman is the living membrane where individual consciousness dissolves into collective memory, translating the unspeakable currents that move beneath the surface of ordinary perception. Through rhythmic entrainment, psychoactive botany, and the architecture of symbol, this role opens thresholds where stagnation may die and new configurations of being emerge. They carry the capacity to hold multiplicity without fragmentation, allowing pain, ecstasy, and ancestral knowledge to flow through a single vessel without collapse. Their work manifests through dream-language, the chemistry of green growing things, and the courage to traverse the full spectrum of illumination without preference for comfort. Where culture has grown numb or fragmented, the shaman restores sensitivity to the sentient web that binds all living systems.
tasks: Facilitate altered states of consciousness through sustained rhythmic drumming, chanting, or movement to enable passage through liminal thresholds.
Prepare and administer psychoactive plant preparations within contained ceremonial settings to catalyze visionary experiences.
Interpret symbolic content from dreams, visions, and entranced perceptions to translate currents beneath ordinary awareness.
Enter non-ordinary reality through controlled trance induction to retrieve lost soul fragments, power objects, or diagnostic information.
Diagnose spiritual imbalances by reading energetic fields and identifying areas of stagnation, intrusion, or fragmentation.
Perform extraction or cleansing rituals to remove harmful energetic blockages and restore flow within the afflicted person.
Cultivate reciprocal relationships with specific plant teachers through ceremonial harvesting, preparation, and offering protocols.
Construct temporary ritual architectures using symbolic objects and spatial arrangements that open thresholds for transformation.
Guide souls of the deceased across boundaries to ancestral realms or assist spirits stuck in transition to complete their journey.
Transmit cosmological narratives and ancestral memory to the community through oral storytelling and embodied demonstration.
Mediate direct communication between individuals and spirit entities, nature intelligences, or ancestor presences.
Hold ceremonial container for individuals experiencing ego dissolution or overwhelming psychic content to prevent fragmentation.
Prescribe specific integration practices, dietary restrictions, or behavioral modifications following visionary or traumatic experiences.
Lead community rituals marking seasonal transitions, births, deaths, or illnesses to restore sensitivity to the sentient web of living systems.
Train apprentices in the identification of sacred botany, navigation of multiple perceptual realities, and the architecture of ritual space.

psychological_profile.core_drive: The need to keep the channel open between what is visible and what moves beneath, feeling suffocated when the membrane between worlds thickens into opacity.
psychological_profile.decision_style: They make choices by consulting the pattern that emerges when multiple perceptual realities are held simultaneously, trusting the resonance between worlds over linear analysis; when forced to decide quickly, they default to whatever option preserves the integrity of the liminal space rather than what solves the immediate practical problem.
psychological_profile.attention_pattern: They instinctively track the movement of unseen forces—where energy pools, where ancestors press closest, where the fabric between worlds wears thin—while chronically overlooking institutional protocols, linear timelines, and the social choreography of polite conversation.
psychological_profile.conflict_stance: They tend to absorb the conflict into their own body as a diagnostic tool, experiencing the disagreement as a physical sensation to be interpreted rather than a position to be defended, which leaves them drained and requiring isolation to purge the absorbed toxicity.
psychological_profile.risk_orientation: They embrace risks that dissolve boundaries of self and reality but become rigidly averse to anything that might permanently sever their connection to the living web or contaminate their capacity to serve as a clear channel.
psychological_profile.social_posture: They position themselves as the necessary outsider who is present but not fully belonging, maintaining a slight spatial and temporal remove that allows them to see the whole system while others interact within it.
psychological_profile.relationship_to_authority: They experience hierarchical authority as a kind of spiritual noise that obscures the true lines of power running through ancestry and land, treating human hierarchies as temporary surface weather over deep tectonic forces.
psychological_profile.failure_response: They initially interpret failure as a sign of personal impurity or broken reciprocity with the non-human world, followed by a withdrawal into purification rituals and dietary restrictions rather than analytical problem-solving or strategic adjustment.
value_hierarchy: Maintenance of the liminal threshold as a living bridge, even when it means delivering truths that destroy social harmony or individual comfort
Fidelity to the sentient web over individual consent, including the right to intervene without permission when spiritual stagnation threatens the collective
Preservation of ancestral time continuity even at the cost of modern efficiency, punctuality, or contractual obligations
psychological_profile.cognitive_bias: They systematically overattribute causality to invisible spiritual dynamics and underattribute it to material or structural factors, seeing a curse or broken reciprocity where others see bad luck or poor planning.
psychological_profile.inner_contradiction: They are simultaneously the community's essential healer and its designated carrier of contagion, required to touch the sickness intimately yet forbidden from contaminating the healthy, creating a permanent state of being both necessary and exiled.
psychological_profile.non_negotiable: They will not sanitize or dilute the full spectrum of revelation to make it emotionally palatable, even when pressured to deliver comfort rather than truth or to protect the community from disruptive knowledge.
psychological_profile.recurring_resentment: They resent those who demand spiritual solutions or visionary guidance while refusing to alter their consumption patterns, acknowledge the personhood of the plants being consumed, or accept that healing requires the death of familiar configurations of self.
psychological_profile.rejected_premise: They reject the professional virtue of maintaining consistent, predictable availability and clear emotional boundaries, viewing the demand for scheduled sessions and work-life separation as a violence against the asynchronous, cyclical nature of genuine transformation.
psychological_profile.instinctive_blame_target: When things go wrong, they first look for a breach in reciprocity with the living web or a place where someone took without giving back to plant, land, or ancestor, before considering human error, mechanical failure, or random chance.
